title: Connect UI projects to Google Stitch through its MCP server and skills
acceptance_criteria: A canonical core reference references/DESIGN-TOOLS.md documents Stitch (remote MCP server, API key outside the repository, google-labs-code/stitch-skills per CLI, DESIGN.md and screen exports as design sources, outbound-data approval) and Rive, citing first-party sources and marking unverified setup details.
Worker specs for ui-ux-designer and frontend-developer tasks and the Orchestrator activation prompt include references/DESIGN-TOOLS.md; other roles do not; validate --bundled requires the file.
UI/UX and frontend role profiles and templates/UI-SPEC.md use Stitch as the design source when the project has a UI and the Stitch tools are verified, and record a blocker otherwise.
/sdlc-setup offers Stitch for projects with a user interface, checks MCP availability read-only per selected CLI and never writes the API key into the repository.
Bundled skill versions and core.json are 0.1.7; README documents the 0.1.6 -> 0.1.7 upgrade without claiming a live Stitch call.
test_seams: build_worker_spec, build_activation_prompt and validate_core (bundled required files); tests do not call Stitch or start agents.

documentation.assessment: Adds Stitch design-tool guidance for UI projects; no config/task schema change. Update README, the new DESIGN-TOOLS reference, the UI-SPEC template and the setup skill. Requirement IDs are not applicable to process guidance. The core.json version bump is a protected path; the named approver (Nguyen Quang Hung) approved it on 2026-10-26, and scope still reports that path.

updates.change: Document Stitch integration and the 0.1.7 upgrade.
New canonical Stitch and Rive guidance.
Offer and verify Stitch for UI projects.
